north_star: ideas must integrate into the full build
new changes must be checked for regressions
new changes must be checked for future complexity
architecture must stay aligned with locked parameters

components.name: Build Coordinator
components.description: Captures ideas, links them to the master build, and powers comparison and audit workflows.
components.build_goal: Every important idea becomes part of the system through linking, timing, and audit visibility.
components.next_missing_layer: Attach ideas to real master components and milestone relevance

components.name: Master Build Registry
components.description: The source of truth for the full architecture, major components, statuses, and dependencies.
components.build_goal: All major systems are explicitly tracked and comparable.
components.next_missing_layer: Complete real component coverage and dependencies

components.name: Dispatch Queue System
components.description: Routes tasks through queued, done, and failed states for work coordination.
components.build_goal: Tasks move cleanly through local routing states with visibility into failures.
components.next_missing_layer: Add audit visibility and stronger failure handling

components.name: Master Route System
components.description: Defines workflow routes and routing logic across the operating system.
components.build_goal: All major flows use explicit route definitions rather than ad hoc behavior.
components.next_missing_layer: Map routes to component dependencies and audits

components.name: Private Confidant Core
components.description: Core local private assistant logic centered on protected handling and trusted behavior.
components.build_goal: Provide protected, aligned local assistant behavior under defined system rules.
components.next_missing_layer: Map behavior to policy and audit layers

components.name: Rexxie Runtime
components.description: Operational assistant runtime with launch scripts, dashboard handoffs, and backing data stores.
components.build_goal: Run a stable local assistant environment with persistent local data and controlled workflows.
components.next_missing_layer: Add runtime-state checking and compatibility audits

components.name: Telegram Bot Interface
components.description: Messaging interface layer for interacting with the system through Telegram.
components.build_goal: Provide a controlled messaging interface into the local system.
components.next_missing_layer: Audit interface behavior against local-only and disclosure rules

components.name: Lane Registry
components.description: Structured registry layer for local state, routing, or relationship tracking.
components.build_goal: Maintain stable structured records used by the local operating system.
components.next_missing_layer: Document schema role and link it to component usage

components.name: Rex Memory Layer
components.description: Local memory and business data layer backed by separate databases.
components.build_goal: Keep assistant memory and business data locally accessible under controlled structure.
components.next_missing_layer: Define access controls and audit data flows

components.name: Client Profile System
components.description: Imports, routes, and templates client profile data for operational use.
components.build_goal: Manage client profile and routing data locally and coherently.
components.next_missing_layer: Audit import flows and data assumptions

components.name: Locked Parameters Layer
components.description: Defines hard constraints and non-negotiable system rules.
components.build_goal: Ensure the system operates under explicit stable constraints.
components.next_missing_layer: Link enforcement logic to runtime and audits

components.name: Operating System Spec
components.description: Formal operating system and prompt/spec definition layer for the build.
components.build_goal: Provide an explicit blueprint for how the system should behave and evolve.
components.next_missing_layer: Map live components directly to spec sections

components.name: Blueprint and Baseline Layer
components.description: Canonical blueprint, baseline inventory, and architecture reference materials.
components.build_goal: Keep a stable reference point for intended architecture and baseline state.
components.next_missing_layer: Consolidate canonical source-of-truth references

components.name: Workflow Audit Layer
components.description: Audit and baseline review layer for workflow and operating integrity.
components.build_goal: Continuously assess whether the operating system matches intended workflow behavior.
components.next_missing_layer: Tie audits to live runtime and snapshots

components.name: Scan Hotfolder
components.description: Local intake point for scans or documents that enter the system.
components.build_goal: Provide a local intake path for incoming scanned content.
components.next_missing_layer: Connect ingestion path to OCR and audit visibility

components.name: Idea Integration Layer
components.description: Ensures saved ideas affect the full build through linking, timing, audits, and roadmap visibility.
components.build_goal: No important idea remains detached from the architecture.
components.next_missing_layer: Add maturity impact and audit visibility for ideas

components.name: Contamination Scanner
components.description: Scans code and configs for cloud, remote, or architecture-contaminating patterns.
components.build_goal: Catch anything that threatens local-only, privacy-first operation.
components.next_missing_layer: Add risk classification and allowed-exception handling

components.name: Regression Auditor
components.description: Checks whether new changes break older systems or working behavior.
components.build_goal: Make breakage visible before it spreads.
components.next_missing_layer: Define snapshot-based tests and expected outcomes

components.name: Forward Impact Auditor
components.description: Checks whether present changes create future complexity, conflicts, or roadmap distortion.
components.build_goal: Protect the future architecture from short-term shortcuts.
components.next_missing_layer: Define complexity scoring and future idea impact rules

components.name: Policy Enforcer
components.description: Deterministic control layer for outputs, permissions, and disclosure behavior.
components.build_goal: Ensure the system follows exact behavioral and disclosure rules.
components.next_missing_layer: Define enforcement rules and hook points
components.note_2026_06_25: PHI fail-closed gate live in main.py (secure cloud chat 503s if de-id engine degraded).

components.name: Secrecy and Disclosure Control
components.description: Sensitivity classification and protected disclosure logic for private information.
components.build_goal: Control what may be revealed, to whom, and under what verification requirements.
components.next_missing_layer: Define secrecy tiers and trigger rules
